sources.title: Velleman — WPSE347: IR speed sensor module

quotes.text:
The WPSE347 is a LM393 speed sensor module, widely used in motor speed detection,
         pulse count, position control, etc.

For example, if you have one hole in the disk and the time between two pulses is 3 seconds,
         you have a revolutions speed of 3 x 60 = 180 rpm. If you have 2 holes in the disk, you have a
         revolutions speed of (3 x 60/2) = 90 rpm.
VCC: module power supply from 3.0 to 12 V.
•   working voltage: 3.3-5 VDC
